title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
This note reports the live paper record as it stands. Every position described here is paper, and no real orders are placed anywhere in this record. A single trade says nothing about a strategy, so the entries below are reported as observations rather than conclusions. Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record.

## What is open on paper

As of the live snapshot read at 2026-11-08T08:45:30.394Z, the live record shows no open paper positions for the three engines listed. htf-rsi-v007 shows 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v005 shows 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v006 shows 0 positions open on paper. The record also notes a NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 that has been open since. Both statements are in the record, and this note does not reconcile them. Because the record is paper, it describes logged signals rather than executed orders, and it does not measure fills, slippage, or costs beyond the stated 30 bps round trip on the ATOM exit.

The phrase "0 positions open on paper" means that, for that engine, no open paper position is listed in the live record at the snapshot time. It does not imply that the engine is inactive, and it does not imply that a future paper signal will or will not appear.

## Closed trades and recent exits

The closed-trade counts and averages are backward-looking summaries of completed paper trades. They do not describe open positions, and they do not predict future trades.

- htf-rsi-v007: 4 closed trades so far, average null net per trade.
- trend-daily-v005: 6 closed trades so far, average -13.22% net per trade.
- trend-daily-v006: 7 closed trades so far, average -13.34% net per trade.

The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. That is one closed paper trade with a negative result, reported as an observation. The exit occurred below the 10-day low, and the reported result includes the 30 bps round trip.

In testing, losses were common and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. The live record so far contains negative averages for trend-daily-v005 and trend-daily-v006, and a null average for htf-rsi-v007. Those are summaries of what has already happened in paper trading, not statements about what will happen next. The closed-trade counts are small: 4, 6, and 7 across the three engines. Small samples can vary, and no conclusion about long-run performance is drawn here.

## Market filter and nearest breakouts

The Bitcoin market filter is off for trend-daily-v005 and trend-daily-v006. That is a statement of filter state in the record. It is not a forecast for Bitcoin, and it is not a signal to take or avoid a trade. The filter state is read from the running record at the snapshot time.

For trend-daily-v005 and trend-daily-v006, the names closest to a 20-day breakout are the same in both records:

- ZECUSDT is 4.65% below its high.
- UNIUSDT is 5.26% below its high.
- BNBUSDT is 8.38% below its high.

These distances are measurements from the live record. They describe how far each name is from its 20-day high. They do not imply that a breakout will or will not occur, and they are not recommendations about any coin.

## Where the record starts and where to check

The live starts are recorded as follows:

- v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026.
- v006 counts its live record from 9 October 2026.

The first live signal remains the ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. The record updates continuously, so the counts and averages can change as new paper signals are logged and closed. A later read may show different counts, different averages, or different open positions. No projection is made from these figures.

The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. The live snapshot was read at 2026-11-08T08:45:30.394Z.
